purpose: Teach: カルシウム/材質/耕作/司教/旧約/起立/見識/人身

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、薬剤のカルシウム成分鑑定を、警察、依頼されますね
lines.en: For this case, the police will need to request forensic analysis of the calcium content in the drug samples, won't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost testing. Measured delivery with slight upward lilt on the final phrase. Soft precision — this is genuine technical curiosity, not performance.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯行に使われた材質を鑑識します
lines.en: The police forensic team analyzes the materials used in the crime.
lines.style: Clear, procedural tone. Even pace, minimal inflection. Speaking from knowledge, not emotion. Brief and factual, like explaining protocol.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、耕作地での盗難事件を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: In this case, the police handle the theft from the cultivation area, don't they?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry with underlying precision. Pause slightly before the final clause. Ren checking his understanding aloud, inviting confirmation without pressing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、司教詐欺事件にも対応します
lines.en: The police also respond to cases involving religious fraud.
lines.style: Steady, informative. Slight emphasis on 'also' — broadening the scope. Professional tone without rigidity. Almost conversational within its formality.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、旧約聖書を悪用したカルト事件を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: For this case involving a cult that misused scripture, the police would handle that as well, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Careful articulation. Measured pace with brief pause before the tag question. Ren's voice carries weight — he's connecting specific details. Quietly intent.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の起立姿勢も観察します
lines.en: The police also observe the suspect's posture and physical demeanor during questioning.
lines.style: Factual, methodical. Steady delivery. No dramatization — just stating another layer of investigative procedure. Clear-eyed and thorough.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、見識の高い専門家を、警察、参考人にされますね
lines.en: In this case, the police would consult with highly knowledgeable experts as key witnesses, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful cadence. Slight rise at 'highly knowledgeable' — respecting expertise. Ren's phrasing respectful but direct. The tag question feels genuinely seeking affirmation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、人身売買事案を国際協力で捜査されますね
lines.en: The police investigate human trafficking cases through international cooperation, don't they?
lines.style: Direct, almost confiding. Kenji's tone is warmer than the procedural exchanges — closer to Takeda. Acknowledging the gravity of the crime without melodrama. Clear and committed.
